Southampton 2-0 Derby: Cyle Larin and Divin Mubama strike in Saints win
Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Southampton and Derby County at St Mary's on Saturday; Cyle Larin and Divin Mubama strike as Saints return to winning ways.
Saturday 21 November 2026 14:36, UK
Cyle Larin returned to action with a bang as Southampton extended their unbeaten run at home in the Championship to 18 games with a 2-0 victory over second-bottom Derby.
Larin turned in his eighth goal of the season but his first since 12 September - after a four-game drought and a hamstring problem.
Divin Mubama added a second in stoppage time as Saints shrugged off worries of failing against lower-placed sides - having dropped points against Watford, Preston, Wrexham, Lincoln and Bolton already this season.
Despite Tonda Eckert signing a new contract and Saints' incredible home form, St Mary's felt subdued on and off the pitch for much of the early kick-off.
The visitors, languishing in the relegation zone came in with a well-drilled defensive gameplan, and the hosts - without injured stars Leo Scienza, Caspar Jander and James Bree - struggled to break through.
Southampton's possession advantage did not translate to chances, as their only first-half shot on target saw Finn Azaz fashion a crafty flick at the near post.
They also struck the crossbar in a rare moment of quality, as Azaz dropped a ball into the six-yard box as Larin saw his stretched volley bounce back off the goal frame.
But it was the visitors that ended the half with more fluidity and had a trio of good efforts.
The lively Mohammed Fuseini flashed a snapshot across the face of goal. Carlton Morris looped a bouncing ball and forced Daniel Peretz into an acrobatic save, before Shane Duffy poked the resulting corner over.
The second half began in a similar manner with Saints struggling to unlock the defence, while the Rams' Fuseini tested Peretz at the other end.
Then, early in the second half, Southampton finally found some joy.
The ground was lifted when Azaz pirouetted in the box and lashed a shot at Jacob Widell Zetterstrom, before James Ward-Prowse's follow-up was blocked.
And that energy brought the opener, as Azaz, Ryan Manning and Samuel Edozie neatly played the ball around before Azaz's low cross was bundled in by Larin in the 57th minute.
The Canadian had missed the last four matches, and was a welcome return after attacking struggles at West Brom and Preston.
Azaz almost followed it up by getting on the scoresheet himself, but he scuffed straight at Zetterstrom from the edge of the area.
Ward-Prowse had a shot deflected over and had the ball in the net, pinging in from the half-way line when the whistle had already gone for an offside as the home team attempted to put the game to bed.
With Zetterstrom up for a corner in the fifth minute of added time, Man City loanee Mubama ran the length of the pitch on the counter to make it 2-0 - celebrating long before slotting home.
